name: Flywheel Incremental: Reforged 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Flywheel Incremental: Reforged is an idle clicker game where your main goal is to reach the highest possible RPM (rotations per minute) by clicking on the flywheel.   To achieve this, you'll need to purchase engines that help you spin the flywheel faster and upgrade the flywheel itself to increase your income.
